content: Jesúsʼba-nanaimalad, Bab-Dummad-obunnogedgi obunnomaloed
Bab-Dummad sogsad, an-obunnogedgi be obunnomaloye. Deyob-anmarga-sogsadyob amba igar anmarga-maisoggu, nue salakarmar, abakalegi bemar gwenna-gwenna a-obunnogedgi obunnoarsurmalale.
We-Gayaburba-Nued anmarga soglesadyob anmar-dadganga soglesmoganad. A-gayaburba-nued-itosmar-inigwele, gwen bendaklessurmalad. Ar ade, itosmargu, Bab-Dummad-bengusmalad.
Ar Bab-Dummad egi-bengusmaladga sogsagusad:

content.text: “Degisoggu, an sae-itogedgine, an weyob ise-sogar sogsa gusad:

content: Salmo 95:11 Ar anmardi Bab-Dummad-bengussurmarsoggu, a-ular, anmardi Bab-Dummad-obunnogedgi obunnomarsunnoed. Ar Bab-Dummad napneg-nasiksagu, bato bela ibmar-imaksad.
Ar Bab-Dummad-Gardagi obunnoged-ibagi weyob sognaid:
Génesis 2:2
Bab-Dummad-Garda-sogedyob gannar an sogbardo, Bab-Dummad sogye:
Salmo 95:11

Anmar-dadgan gayaburba-nued-itosmar-inigwele, Bab-Dummad-sogedba ibmar imaksasurmalad. Agala, gwen obunnogedse dogsasurmalad. Degi-inigwele, baigandi amba bukidar Bab-Dummad-obunnogedgi sunna obunnodamarsundo.
A-ular, Bab-Dummad gannar iba nasiknonikid, soged: “Emi-ibaginye.” Dikasurgus deyob-sogsad, emidi, Davidʼbali anmarga sognaid:

content.text: melle be-dadgan Bab-Dummadgi gwisgus-gusmaladyob, bur bule burgumalo.”

content: Salmo 95:7-8
Ar Josué anmar-dadgan obunnogega-imaksana, Bab-Dummad a-sorbali, bar obunnoged-baidgi sunmaksasulinad.
Degisoggu, Babba-nanaimalad obunnoged-baid ega nue-maisunnad.
Ar dule Bab-Dummad-obunnogedgi obunnosale, na e-arbaedgi obunnomogad. Ar igi Bab-Dummad e-arbasad-sorba obunnosmoga, deyobi, obunnomogad.
Degisoggu, a-obunnogedgi anmar obunnomogagala, nue-alamaknai imakmarsun, adi, melle anmar uayasuli anmar-dadgan-gusadyob gumarmogagar.

content.text: Dogedi, san-burbaginse-bakar, doged, anmar-burbase amba dogbalid.
Deginbali, dule-binsaed, e-gwage-ibmar-imakbied bela mag dakbalid.

content: Bela-ibmar-obinnilesadi, Bab-Dummadgi dukunaisulid, bela e-asabin magar-daklenaidbiid. Anmar-Bab-Dummadga-ibmar-sogoedgi, ibmar dukunaisulid.
Jesús, Bab-Dummad-Machi dule-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummad nibnegse dogsad. Agala, anmar Jesúsʼgi-bensulidgi gatik-akanai gumarsun.
Ar anmar-irwa-Bab-Dummadse-goled-bur-dummad anmar-sunna wilubdaklesmogad, degite, gwen isgussulid, a-ular, anmar-nollo-itogedgi nabir wile anmar-daksunnad.
Degisoggu, anmar Bab-Dummad-dulemar-sabgumaid-e-ologanase bensulidba walikgumarsun. Adi, Bab-Dummad wile-anmar-dakega, degi, bonigan-abargi anmar-bendake-wilubsulinadgi anmar-bendakegar.
